evidence: src/domain/errors.ts: DomainError, with subclasses ValidationError, NotFoundError and ConflictError, is the shared error abstraction.
src/domain/project.ts, src/domain/user.ts, src/domain/task.ts and src/domain/task-status.ts all throw ValidationError or ConflictError imported from ./errors.
src/domain/task-status.ts: TASK_STATUSES, TaskStatus and parseTaskStatus are the single source of truth for status values.
src/domain/task.ts (TaskProps.status: TaskStatus) and src/domain/task-repository.ts (TaskFilter.status?: TaskStatus) both use the shared TaskStatus type.
src/domain/project-repository.ts, src/domain/user-repository.ts and src/domain/task-repository.ts declare matching save/findById ports, one per entity.
src/domain/id-generator.ts: the IdGenerator port is a domain-level abstraction consistent with the other ports.
src/domain/project.ts and src/domain/user.ts each check that the name is not empty. These are separate per-entity invariants with distinct messages, not one rule duplicated.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: The src/domain module covers one concern: the task-management domain model. It holds the entities (Project, User, Task), a value type (TaskStatus), repository and id-generator ports, and a shared error hierarchy. Every file uses the module's own abstractions the same way. All invariant failures throw subclasses of DomainError from errors.ts. TaskStatus comes from a single source of truth, TASK_STATUSES in task-status.ts, which both task.ts and task-repository.ts use. Each repository interface follows the same save/findById shape and refers to its own entity. Nothing bypasses these abstractions: no file defines its own error type or its own list of status values. Project and User both check that the name is not empty. That is a small structural similarity, but each check protects that entity's own invariant with its own message, so it isn't one rule duplicated across places. Task.create and markDone use the status literals 'todo' and 'done', but these are checked against the TaskStatus type, so the list of allowed values still lives in one place.
